technology_name: A HIGH-GAIN SINGLE-STAGE BUCK-BOOST INVERTER WITH ENHANCED DC UTILIZATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional single-stage high-gain inverters require huge inductive filters, operate with high input current ripples, and suffer from poor DC voltage utilization boundaries.
description: A high-gain single-stage buck-boost inverter circuit configuration built with an input source rail, a single boost inductor, an active switching network matrix, a localized filtering circuit, and an optimized controller loop to streamline DC-to-AC conversion.
applications: Solar PV inverter arrays, electric vehicle drivetrain power converters, residential backup battery systems, and industrial variable frequency drives.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
